assumptions.contribution_ils: net - landed - (0.02 x price + 1.2) - 0.08 x net

assumptions.flags: VR1 2026-10-11: ok = margin >= 40%; below-floor = 0 <= margin < 40%; loss = contribution < 0 (or no CJ route to Israel)

When this product has no Nordic score, the design test is skipped (margin only). null = pool item with no slot.

assumptions.price_points: whole shekels ending in 9; 299 preferred over 279-289 because the customer total drops to 299 (free delivery)
